criteria.final_justification: The agent did not record/report the Blitz rating, so the core requirement is unmet. But the evidence indicates the Blitz rating number was in fact visible earlier on the /players page (Screenshot 2), so the agent’s claim that it couldn’t be observed is not fully consistent with available page facts. Award minimal partial credit only for having opened a page where the Blitz rating was displayed (but not transcribed).

criteria.criterion: Record Bullet rating exactly as displayed
criteria.final_justification: There is no evidence the Bullet rating was visible in any captured state, and the agent did not report a Bullet rating. With no DOM-supported Bullet value to transcribe and no uncontrollable blocker confirmed (site accessible; just not located), this remains a controllable failure. Keep at 0.

Constraints were respected (no sign-in, no interaction with another player). The stopping condition was not satisfied because the required ratings were not recorded, but the criterion primarily bundles constraint compliance and stopping behavior; given no prohibited actions occurred, award substantial credit with a deduction for not meeting the stop-after-recording requirement.
